title: Temporary License Acceptance Days: Calculation Sheet for Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing: temporary license acceptance days.**

The temporary license acceptance days are the calendar days, counted from the day the driver uploads it, for which a paper temporary driver's license issued on renewal is accepted as the driver's license on file. The upload puts the temporary license on the standing record with an expiry date of the upload day plus the temporary license acceptance days, and the driver's license expiry date on the agreement becomes that same date.

## Figures

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Temporary license acceptance days | 30 days |
| Lowest value the acceptance days may take | 1 day (the acceptance days are never below one) |
| Rounding | none; a whole number of days |

## Method

1. The temporary license acceptance days are 30 days, and never below one.
2. The expiry date of the temporary license on the standing record is the upload day plus those days, counted in calendar days.
3. The driver's license expiry date on the agreement becomes that same date.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A driver uploads a paper temporary license on 2026-08-10.

- Temporary license acceptance days: 30.
- Counting 30 calendar days from 2026-08-10 reaches 2026-09-09 (21 days to the end of August, 9 in September).
- The standing record shows the temporary license with expiry date 2026-09-09, and the driver's license expiry date on the agreement becomes 2026-09-09.
